map.像素 4µm、400mm：像素级极限光圈 ≈ 像素×2.44×λ 反推约 f/2: 4um pixel, 400mm: pixel-level limit aperture ~ derived from pixel x 2.44 x lambda ~ f/29; too-small aperture softens via diffraction, landscapes commonly best at f/8-f/11.

map.避开最大光圈像差与最小光圈衍射，多数镜头 f/5.6–f/11 锐度峰值。: Avoid the widest-aperture aberration and smallest-aperture diffraction; most lenses peak at f/5.6-f/11.
